AIPack is a directory of AI tools. Tap a tool to open its website in your browser.
Most labels are estimates and have not been tested from inside Iran yet. They are shown as est. Access can change at any time and depends on your network and provider.
Some Iranian services are gateways: they resell access to foreign models, so your conversations pass through a third party. Their claims are their own and are not independently verified.
